task: T2: add the event ledger to scripts/dispatch/dispatcher.py. Define `already_seen(ledger_path, event_id)` returning True when that id has been actioned before, and `record_seen(ledger_path, event_id)` appending it. The ledger is a plain text file, one id per line. A missing ledger file is NOT an error — a fresh dispatcher has actioned nothing, so `already_seen` returns False and `record_seen` creates the file, creating any missing parent directory. Both functions must tolerate an unreadable or unwritable path without raising: losing the ledger degrades dedupe, and a dispatcher that crashes on a full disk is worse than one that occasionally repeats. This is deliberately separate from the Matrix sync cursor: the cursor may be lost on restart, and the ledger is what makes a replayed event harmless, so do not combine them.
